column25:
When you first sign up for Late League, your first 5 games will be your placement games.  Your win/loss record in these first 5 games determine your initial rank on the leaderboards. Each placement match adjusts your MMR using the following criteria:

5-0 = Silver 1
4-1 = Silver 2
3-2 = Silver 3
2-3 = Bronze 1
1-4 = Bronze 2
0-5 = Bronze 3
